description: VERIFY-WITHOUT-TRUST: read the escrow straight from the Midnight indexer (dual-source when configured, fail-closed) and get the raw chain projection + verification metadata. No booking details, no identities - only what the chain itself says. Public: no token needed. escrow_id and contract come from a booking escrow_ref (everlist_booking / get_order_status responses) or the /verify link.

contract.description: escrow contract address (optional when the hub has HUB_ESCROW_CONTRACT configured)

escrow_id.description: chain escrow id from the booking escrow_ref

name: everlist_escrow_proof
